gbm_population_evidence.quote: Has participated in and completed all protocol-specified treatments through the required study observation period or time of closure for a prior Bexion-sponsored BXQ-350 clinical study

gbm_population_flag.reason: Rollover study for any prior BXQ-350 participants; glioblastoma named only in keywords (not an allowed field under C7/D27B), though GBM patients from parent studies are likely eligible.

candidate_evidence.quote: BXQ-350 is a novel anti-neoplastic therapeutic agent configured from two components: Saposin C (SapC), an expressed (human) lysosomal protein, and the phospholipid dioleoylphosphatidyl-serine (DOPS), a phospholipid located on cell membranes (clinical formulation BXQ-350).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This study is intended only for those who have completed the required study observation period or are still on treatment upon the closure of their respective BXQ-350 clinical study.

role_evidence.quote: BXQ-350 will be administered intravenously at the same dose level and frequency the subject was receiving at the end of the prior BXQ-350 clinical study.

coder_notes: Open-label rollover/continued-access study for participants of prior BXQ-350 studies (any tumour; stdAges CHILD, ADULT, OLDER_ADULT). Conditions 'Neoplasms'; glioblastoma and high-grade glioma appear only in keywords, so per C7 GBM is not named in an allowed field; coded not_glioblastoma (flag uncertain). Basket coded true as it is a multi-tumour continuation study. BXQ-350 is a two-component nanovesicle (saposin C + DOPS) registered as one product; listed as one row under its development code.
